Author: Mayo Botic, Ultranova Violet
Name: PF Analysis
Description: Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; watch your listing and party as it fills; and look up party members' progression and community ratings.
Punchline: Run your Party Finder: presets, party progression, and player lookups.
Changelog: New badges: the Achievements tab now tells you how many clears people have posted since you last looked, and the Vote tab marks itself when there's a poll waiting - both show even when the window is rolled up. The fight your party recruited for now stays on screen once you're full. There's also a "Read the update" button in About if you want to know where the plugin is heading.
